title: Homework: Security Review of a Generated Change
objective: Review a generated refund function, classify each finding by its category, write a fix for each one, and confirm the fixed function with the cases the rule requires.
prerequisites: Never Feed Generated Code Into a Runtime Evaluator
expected:
log: refund requested by ana for order 1
ana refunds order 1 for 10: refunded 10
log: refund requested by ben for order 1
ben refunds order 1 for 10: refused
log: refund requested by ana for order 1
ana refunds order 1 for -5: refused
log: refund requested by ana for order 1
ana refunds order 1 for 50: refused
